title: Trust services and delegation

statement.en: The governance authority shall remain accountable for every check and shall name who executes and who reviews it; these may differ. Where an accreditor exists it shall be named and shall not assess a service it operates; no rulebook is required to create one.

control: The responsibility matrix names executor and reviewer for each check; review records kept

expressions.note: Checked by people. The accountable and executor fields of each rule record already carry part of it.
